title: Foundry Net vs frozen Vanguard
intro: Outcome-labelled six-cell exhibition of a third, independent archetype. Foundry Net invests in persistent map hardware rather than recognizing this opponent.

cards.trigger: A builder reaches its mapped staging area with its signature ready.
cards.tactic: Minesmith circuits two trip anchors, Nest holds a sentry anchor, Mason blocks the enemy gate, and Lantern scouts over a small courier spine.
cards.counterplay: Destroy or route around the fixed hardware, pressure the builders, or keep loose Cores spawning far enough apart to pull them off setup.
cards.fallback: Every specialist still hands off, scores, recovers, collects, and fights when construction is unavailable.
cards.watch: Construct uses begin at t15 and continue through t318; 5 mines, 3 sentries, and 15 blocks are issued.

cards.trigger: Minesmith and Nest reach their stages, while Mason never gets a legal gate placement in this cell.
cards.tactic: The centre mine/sentry circuit still forms; the absence of a block is exposed rather than hidden.
cards.counterplay: Vanguard prevents the far Mason setup and attacks the remaining fixed hardware.
cards.fallback: Mason continues Core work and ordinary combat instead of fabricating an illegal placement.
